what: Control run: can a cloud session reproduce stage 4 without the by-name agents?
why: A cloud session cannot spawn sense-ranker/enricher/entry-reader/null-auditor: agent types are fixed at session start and .claude/agents/ on the device is not read. The proposed substitute was general-purpose agents with the model forced to opus/fable and the rubric read verbatim from file. This run measures that substitute against a known answer.
method: The same 5 ranker packets and the same 50 entries as enrich-002. Rubric read from file, not paraphrased. Model forced to opus. Effort NOT settable - this is the known deviation.

harness.authoring: general-purpose agent, model=opus, effort=UNSET (instrument file asks for high)

reading_of_the_disagreements.time/noun: clear fault - put 'the continuum of experience' first AND in met, the exact sense the rubric and census 002 both record as used by no sentence; three sentences carry the indefinite-period sense
reading_of_the_disagreements.make/verb: broad-light-verb-first, the documented anti-pattern; 'give certain properties' over 'perform, produce, or carry out' which two sentences plainly carry
reading_of_the_disagreements.take/verb: same class - 'carry out' over 'take somebody somewhere', which 'take his guest into the drawing-room' plainly carries

cost.note: the ranking pass ALONE costs 47% more than ranking and enriching together did by name

verdict: REJECTED. Three of five disagreements are the specific failure class the rubric was written to prevent, concentrated on the high-sense-count words (make 49 senses, take 42) where the missing effort:high would be expected to bite. And the cost does not fit: extrapolated to 878 entries the generation passes alone come to roughly 16M tokens against an 8M stage-7 cap.
conclusion: Stage 7 needs either an API key (model AND effort set exactly, cheapest per entry, harness-independent) or a session opened on this repo, where the four instrument files resolve by name.
